name: YemenNet-PTC data center (Aljeraf, Sana'a)
notes: Directory listing (Data Center Platform) places the YemenNet-PTC facility of state-owned Yemen Telecom (operator of the YemenNet ISP) at Aljeraf Street, Sana'a; a PeeringDB-derived listing also shows it as an operational interconnection facility in Sana'a. It is Yemen's main national ISP/telco data center; no public MW capacity disclosed and no independent verification available given the conflict environment.

name: TeleYemen Sana'a international gateway and data hosting facility
notes: TeleYemen's HQ/international gateway building in Sanaa housed telco equipment, servers and provided web hosting, data transmission, domain and IP services (Sana'a Center policy brief, Jan 11 2021). DCD (Feb 14 2022) reports the building was destroyed by a Saudi-led coalition airstrike; the company said it would resume services. Not a commercial colocation facility; current status unverified, hence 'unknown'.
